materialChanges: Separated chance-based sequence generation from concealment and faithful implementation, including the conditional predictability of restricted methods, across learner prose, feedback, claims, glossary, assessment reasoning, and the timeline equivalent.

Limited the claim that concealment is always arrangeable to the individually randomized, person-by-person setting taught by the core examples and added explicit boundaries for other allocation orders.

Made the breathing-study concealment conclusion auditable by placing recorded consent and enrolment before reveal and assigning sequence and envelope preparation and control to an independent data officer.
Corrected the all-bookings practice population and retained the essay study's total-package estimand while describing the crossed, counterbalanced requirements of a separate rules-focused study.

Changed the clinical crossover synthesis to claims-mapped, added its learner-visible source note and claim mappings, and narrowed it to a four-question retrieval audit that does not claim full crossover validity.
Updated finalizer attribution and provenance without changing lesson identity, version, status, references, third-party assets, or either review artifact.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The assignment explanation, claim ledger, worked feedback, glossary, assessment reasoning, and timeline now state that the prespecified chance mechanism removes discretionary sequence choice when followed, while concealment and faithful implementation prevent an enroller from exploiting an upcoming assignment to manipulate participant-to-assignment pairings.

Random allocation is no longer defined by an unpredictable next result. The revised definition uses a prespecified chance mechanism and assignment probabilities, and the prose, claim, glossary, worked example, and shuffled-deck feedback distinguish conditional foreseeability in restricted methods from sequence-generation failure.

Every categorical always-achievable statement is now limited to the individually randomized, person-by-person setting taught in the core route. The synthesis and claim uncertainty explicitly require a design-specific audit when allocation occurs before individual recruitment.

The clinical scene is now claims-mapped, its six material methodological claims resolve to the two existing sources through a same-scene source note, and its claim and prose scope are narrowed to order assignment and the four-question audit without asserting full crossover validity.

The incompatible double-marking repair was removed. The existing study now retains the randomized total-package estimand; a separate rules-focused design is described only with crossed and counterbalanced rubric assignments, graders using both rubrics across different essays, controlled repeat exposure and order, and essay and grader effects represented in analysis.
Practice 1 now defines the study population as patients with booked appointments, including later non-attenders, and treats attendance only as the post-assignment outcome.

The fictional protocol now records eligibility, informed consent, acceptance, and enrolment irreversibly before opening the next envelope. An independent data officer generates and controls the master sequence and prepares the numbered opaque sealed envelopes, with the assistant unable to access the sequence.
The reviewed ROBES and MetaBLIND sample sizes, ratios of odds ratios, credible intervals, arithmetic interpretations, and warnings against individual-trial correction factors remain unchanged.

The concrete opening, stated purpose, four-question route, and absence of project-governance vocabulary were preserved; the bounded methodological corrections do not alter the successful first-read structure.

The positive learning-design judgment was preserved as far as possible, but its statement that the clinical scene introduced no material claims was not accepted. The academic review correctly identified material external-validity, allocation, concealment, blinding, and result-handling claims, so the scene required claim mapping, a source note, and a narrower crossover boundary.
The exact frozen candidate at d33191a7f1a26a7e85e7f595e40d00ad3c3b8386 already records assessment.json lessonVersion as 0.2.0, matching lesson.json and the other ledgers; changing it was unnecessary.
The three-stage fading sequence and reasoning-rich feedback in the practice scene remain intact; only the reviewed population label and restricted-randomization clarification changed.
The open-response item's four-part audit, effect-of-interest distinction, outcome and objective mappings, analytic rubric, retry policy, and remediation remain aligned and unchanged.
